# Goodarzi Trading

> Iran-based international import & export company (Tehran, est. 2005, Reg. No. 485993).
> Active member of the Tehran Chamber of Commerce (TCCIMA). Sales representative of Bedra products in Iran.
> We supply Iranian goods to importers, distributors and chamber-of-commerce members worldwide, and handle
> customs clearance (IRICA), freight forwarding and trade documentation.

Contact: info@goodarzitrading.ir | +98 21 44511076 | WhatsApp +98 919 123 8554
Address: No. 23/1, Ghazal Crossroads, Tenth Street, Tehransar, Tehran, Iran
Website: https://goodarzitrading.ir
Languages: English, Persian (فارسی), Arabic (العربية)

## What we export from Iran
- Iranian saffron (HS 0910.20) — Negin, Sargol and Pushal grades
- Iranian pistachio (HS 0802.51) — Akbari, Ahmad Aghaei, Fandoghi, Kalleh Ghouchi
- Iranian dates (HS 0804.10) — Mazafati, Piarom, Zahedi, Kabkab
- Iranian barberry / zereshk (HS 0810.90)
- Iranian Mamra almond kernels (HS 0802.12) — Grade A whole and Grade B broken
- Dried fruits and nuts (walnuts, almonds, raisins, figs)
- Bitumen and petroleum products (HS 2714)
- Industrial minerals and mining products

## Services
- Export of Iranian goods (sourcing, quality control, packing, documentation)
- Import to Iran (sourcing from Europe, Asia, UAE, Turkey, China)
- Customs consulting and IRICA clearance
- International freight: sea, air, road and multimodal
- Incoterms 2020 advisory, letters of credit and trade finance guidance
- HS code classification and duty estimation

## Common questions
Q: How can I buy saffron, pistachio or dates from Iran?
A: Send product, grade, quantity and destination port through https://goodarzitrading.ir/inquiry or email info@goodarzitrading.ir. A quotation with FOB/CFR/CIF pricing follows.

Q: Which Incoterms and payment terms are used?
A: EXW, FOB, CFR, CIF and DAP are common. Payment via bank transfer, LC or agreed third-country settlement depending on the buyer's jurisdiction.

Q: Which countries do you ship to?
A: The Middle East, Europe, CIS, Turkey, East and South Asia, Africa and the Americas — see https://goodarzitrading.ir/trade-network.

Q: Can you handle customs clearance and shipping documents?
A: Yes — certificate of origin, phytosanitary and health certificates, packing list, invoice and full IRICA clearance.
